where: Worked example 1, step 7 and answer; also Section 2, last sentence
problem: The example cures a shear deficiency (τ_v = 0.53 > τ_c ≈ 0.42 N/mm²) by adding 8 mm two-legged stirrups at 300 mm c/c inside a 200 mm footing. IS 456 does not require shear reinforcement in footings; the standard remedy is to increase the depth until τ_v ≤ τ_c. Even if stirrups were allowed, 0.34 mm²/mm is far below the minimum shear reinforcement of 0.4b/(0.87 f_y) = 0.4 × 1000/(0.87 × 415) = 1.11 mm²/mm for Fe415, and 300 mm spacing exceeds the maximum spacing of about 91 mm that this minimum implies. The example therefore ends with a design that fails the code.
fix: Increase the depth instead: with D = 250 mm, d = 195 mm, x = 0.485 − 0.195 = 0.29 m, V_u = 65.3 kN/m, τ_v = 0.33 N/mm², which is below τ_c ≈ 0.42 N/mm² for p_t ≈ 0.29%. Adopt B = 1.2 m and D = 250 mm with main 10 mm @ 140 mm c/c and distribution 8 mm @ 200 mm c/c, no stirrups. Delete the sentence about stirrups being common in worked examples, and change Section 2 to: 'If τ_v exceeds τ_c, increase D; shear reinforcement is not provided in footings.'

problem: The second half of the answer, 'the section closer to the face has already been used for bending', is not a reason for the d offset and would mislead a student. Bending and shear are separate checks; the section at the face is not 'used up' by bending.
fix: Answer: The load within a distance d of the wall face is carried straight into the wall by diagonal compression, so a diagonal tension crack cannot form there. A crack can start only at about d from the face, so IS 456 clause 34.2.4.1 makes the section at distance d the critical section for one-way shear.

problem: The flow shows service soil pressure 150 kN/m² leading to a moment of 26.5 kN·m/m. A student who multiplies 150 × 0.485²/2 gets 17.6 kN·m/m, not 26.5 kN·m/m, because the moment uses the factored pressure of 225 kN/m².
fix: Label the node 'Factored soil pressure 225 kN/m²' (the safe pressure 150 kN/m² can stay on the width node), so the link from pressure to moment is consistent.

where: Exam traps, second trap; and Quiz Q2 answer
problem: 'The critical section is at the wall face, where the cantilever is longest' is loose wording: the cantilever length a is the same at every section. What is largest at the wall face is the distance from that section to the free edge, which is the lever arm of the whole projection.
fix: Write: 'The critical section is at the wall face, because that section carries the full projection a as its lever arm; at every section closer to the free edge the remaining projection, and hence the moment, is smaller.' In Q2, replace 'The cantilever projection is longest there' with 'The full projection a acts as the lever arm there'.
